## Repository layout

| Path | Holds |
|---|---|
| `.claude-plugin/` | `plugin.json` and `marketplace.json` |
| `hooks/` | The three hooks and their shared `lib.js` |
| `rules/` | Core, house and language rules injected each session |
| `skills/` | The persona, rule-management skills, `figure-style` and the 21 pipeline skills |
| `templates/` | `plots.*`, `theme.*`, `palettes.*`, `skillkit.py` and the air, ruff and lintr configs |
| `bench/` | acumen benchmarks: with and without the skills |
| `docs/` | The pipeline skill contract and the ClawBio determinism plan |
| `site/` | This website |

## Tests

Hooks, rules and templates:

```bash
npm test   # node --test tests/*.test.js
```

Each pipeline skill has its own pytest suite. Run it with the exact `uv run`
line in that skill's `references/maintainer.md`, for example:

```bash
cd skills/group-tests
uv run --python 3.12 --with numpy,pandas,scipy,matplotlib,plotnine-extra,pytest \
  python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests
```

## Vendored helpers

Each pipeline skill folder is self-contained, so it carries byte-identical
copies of `templates/plots.py`, `theme.py`, `palettes.py` and `skillkit.py`.
A test in each skill fails when a copy drifts. After editing a template, copy
it into every skill:

```bash
for d in skills/*/scripts/plots.py; do cp templates/plots.py "$d"; done
```

## Adding a pipeline skill

Follow the contract in
[`docs/pipeline-skills.md`](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/docs/pipeline-skills.md).
Copy the shape of `skills/pseudobulk-de/`: a `SKILL.md` contract, one script
entry point, a seeded demo generator, demo data under 1 MB, and tests for the
demo golden values, the output tree and every `ERROR` string.

## Benchmarks

`bench/` holds [acumen](https://github.com/scverse/acumen) projects that run
the same tasks with and without a skill. `docs/clawbio-determinism/BENCH.md`
records the results.

## This site

The site is Quarto, in `site/`. The gallery images come from the template
self-check:

```bash
uv run --with plotnine-extra,pandas,numpy python site/make_figures.py
quarto preview site
```

A push to `main` that touches `site/` rebuilds the site and deploys it to
GitHub Pages through `.github/workflows/docs.yml`.
